records: Bithomp's Binance labels and account-clustering metadata are third-party attribution, not cryptographic proof of legal ownership or operator authorization. The 11.141M XRP and 51.172508M RLUSD transfers from rDAE53 to the old Binance-labelled rs8ZPb account strongly support internal consolidation/recovery, but the signing operator and approval are unknown. The attacker receiver rK21t6 was last reported with no outgoing XRP through 07:36 UTC; later disposition is unknown. XRPLWin reports no RLUSD issuer freeze transactions on XRPL Oct25-30, but no independent exhaustive issuer-account audit was completed in this run. The 40.5M Ripple freeze was reported on Ethereum and must not be generalized to XRPL. Binance's October 1 XRP PoR address-set crosswalk and post-incident reserve ratio remain unverified.
